preflight_probes.purpose: Verify behavior of extra JSON fields (system_prompt, temperature, etc.)
preflight_probes.findings: The Language Server Protobuf parser deserializes strictly `prompt` (field 1) and `model` (field 2). Extra fields such as `system_prompt`, `system`, or `temperature` are completely ignored by the Go protobuf deserializer and do not affect the backend model call.
